description: Defines the DataObjects_Agency class for managing agency records in the Revive Adserver project, including CRUD operations, account and user management, and audit features.

classes.name: DataObjects_Agency
classes.description: A PHP class representing the 'agency' table with methods for CRUD operations, account/user management, and audit logging within the Revive Adserver system.

methods.name: staticGet
methods.description: Static method to retrieve an agency record based on a key-value pair.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Handles creation of a new agency, including account and user setup, and triggers post-creation hooks.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing agency record, manages associated user data, and updates account name.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the agency record and associated account.

methods.name: _auditEnabled
methods.description: Indicates audit logging is enabled for this class.

methods.name: _getContextId
methods.description: Returns the context ID for auditing.

methods.name: _getContext
methods.description: Returns the context name 'Agency' for auditing.

methods.name: _buildAuditArray
methods.description: Builds an audit log array with agency-specific details.

methods.name: agencyExists
methods.description: Checks if an agency with the given name exists.

methods.name: belongsToAccount
methods.description: Checks if the agency belongs to a specific account, considering admin privileges.
